description: Formalize namespace boundaries, align Reach with Covenant ownership, and review each layer from the zero-dependency primitives to application composition. The goal is a smaller library with clear owners, one-way dependencies, and contract proof.

comments.text: Quality foundation rule: restore reference authoring, example, property, system, load, and benchmark backpressure before production-code reduction starts. The foundation tasks must not change jido/lib. Record a production gap as a follow-up issue.

title: Improve Jido architecture quality after consolidation
